# About this script

Imports the raw MIDUS 2 data, builds the daily TV and sleep variables,
aligns day-t TV with night-t sleep, creates the employment and health
filter variables, and saves the analytic datasets used by the
`M2_modeling_*.Rmd` scripts.

# Packages

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Importing MIDUS 2 data

Download the `.rda` files from ICPSR (see README) and put them in the
`data/` folder at the top of the project. All paths are relative to
this script's folder, which is the working directory when it is knit.

```{r}
# ICPSR files, relative to this script's folder (scripts/<wave>/)
data_dir <- file.path("..", "..", "data")
if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) {
  stop("Put the ICPSR .rda files in the data/ folder at the top of the project (see README).")
}

# MIDUS 2 main survey (ICPSR 4652, https://doi.org/10.3886/ICPSR04652.v8)
load(file.path(data_dir, "04652-0001-Data.rda"))

# MIDUS 2 Daily Stress Project / NSDE II (ICPSR 26841, https://doi.org/10.3886/ICPSR26841.v2)
load(file.path(data_dir, "26841-0001-Data.rda"))
```

# Structuring MIDUS 2 data

```{r}
# Pulling from daily diary data
M2_diary_data <- da26841.0001 %>%
  transmute(
    id = M2ID,

    # Family ID. Milwaukee participants have no M2FAMNUM, so each gets a
    # unique placeholder (their negated M2ID) so no one is treated as related.
    M2FAMNUM = if_else(is.na(M2FAMNUM), -M2ID, M2FAMNUM),

    age = B1PAGE_M2,

    # 0 = male, 1 = female
    sex = case_when(
      readr::parse_number(as.character(B1PGENDER)) == 1 ~ 0,
      readr::parse_number(as.character(B1PGENDER)) == 2 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    diary_day = readr::parse_number(as.character(B2DDAY)),
    # 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday
    weekday = readr::parse_number(as.character(B2DWEEKD)),

    wake_hour = B2DWAKE1,
    wake_minute = B2DWAKE2,
    wake_ampm = B2DWAKE3,

    sleep_hours = B2DAW1CH,
    sleep_minutes = B2DAW1CM,

    tv_hours = B2DAW4H,
    tv_minutes = B2DAW4M,

    work_hours = B2DA3H,
    work_minutes = B2DA3M,

    work_start_hour = B2DA3AH2,
    work_start_minute = B2DA3AM2,
    work_start_ampm = B2DA3AAP,

    work_end_hour = B2DA3BH2,
    work_end_minute = B2DA3BM2,
    work_end_ampm = B2DA3BAP,

    # Daily number of stressors
    number_stressors = readr::parse_number(
      as.character(B2DN_STR)
    ),

    # Average stressor severity (0 = "Not at all" to 3 = "Very").
    # MIDUS leaves this missing on days with zero stressors; recoded to 0
    # on interviewed days, while days with no interview stay missing.
    stressor_severity_average = case_when(
      readr::parse_number(as.character(B2DN_STR)) == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ readr::parse_number(as.character(B2DSSEVA))
    ),

    physical_activity_hours = B2DA4AH,
    physical_activity_minutes = B2DA4AM
  )

# Health variables from the M2 parent survey
# (does not include the Milwaukee participants)
M2_parent_data <- da04652.0001 %>%
  transmute(
    id = M2ID,

    head_injury = case_when(
      readr::parse_number(as.character(B1PA6B)) == 1 ~ 1,
      readr::parse_number(as.character(B1PA6B)) == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    neurological_disorder = case_when(
      readr::parse_number(as.character(B1PA6D)) == 1 ~ 1,
      readr::parse_number(as.character(B1PA6D)) == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    chronic_sleep_problem = case_when(
      readr::parse_number(as.character(B1SA11W)) == 1 ~ 1,
      readr::parse_number(as.character(B1SA11W)) == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# Health variables for the Milwaukee participants come from the
# RESTRICTED-USE MIDUS 2 Milwaukee file (ICPSR 22840,
# https://doi.org/10.3886/ICPSR22840.v7), which requires an ICPSR
# restricted-data agreement. Without it, these participants' health
# variables stay missing, which only affects the no-health-conditions sample.
milwaukee_file <- file.path(data_dir, "22840-0001-Data-REST.rda")

if (file.exists(milwaukee_file)) {
  load(milwaukee_file)

  M2_milwaukee_data <- da22840.0001 %>%
    transmute(
      id = M2ID,

      head_injury = case_when(
        readr::parse_number(as.character(BACA6B)) == 1 ~ 1,
        readr::parse_number(as.character(BACA6B)) == 2 ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),

      neurological_disorder = case_when(
        readr::parse_number(as.character(BACA6D)) == 1 ~ 1,
        readr::parse_number(as.character(BACA6D)) == 2 ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),

      chronic_sleep_problem = case_when(
        readr::parse_number(as.character(BACAS11W)) == 1 ~ 1,
        readr::parse_number(as.character(BACAS11W)) == 2 ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    )
} else {
  message("Restricted Milwaukee file not found: Milwaukee health variables will be NA.")

  M2_milwaukee_data <- tibble(
    id = M2_diary_data$id[0],
    head_injury = numeric(),
    neurological_disorder = numeric(),
    chronic_sleep_problem = numeric()
  )
}

# Combining the data
M2_long <- M2_diary_data %>%
  left_join(M2_parent_data, by = "id") %>%
  left_join(M2_milwaukee_data, by = "id", suffix = c("", "_milwaukee")) %>%
  mutate(
    head_injury = coalesce(head_injury, head_injury_milwaukee),
    neurological_disorder = coalesce(neurological_disorder, neurological_disorder_milwaukee),
    chronic_sleep_problem = coalesce(chronic_sleep_problem, chronic_sleep_problem_milwaukee)
  ) %>%
  select(-head_injury_milwaukee, -neurological_disorder_milwaukee, -chronic_sleep_problem_milwaukee)

# QC: joining should not add or drop rows
stopifnot(
  nrow(M2_long) == nrow(M2_diary_data),
  n_distinct(M2_long$id) == n_distinct(M2_diary_data$id)
)
```

# Siblings and twins

```{r}
# Number of sibling and twin participants
da26841.0001 %>%
  filter(SAMPLMAJ %in% c("(02) Sibling", "(03) Twin")) %>%
  group_by(SAMPLMAJ) %>%
  summarise(
    participants = n_distinct(M2ID),
    rows = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Main sample without siblings and twins (used for the no_sibtwin dataset)
M2_main_sample <- da26841.0001 %>%
  filter(
    !SAMPLMAJ %in% c("(02) Sibling", "(03) Twin")
  )
```

# Converting 12-hour clock times to minutes since midnight

```{r}
convert_to_minutes <- function(hour, minute, ampm) {

  ampm_clean <- case_when(
    grepl("AM", ampm, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "AM",
    grepl("PM", ampm, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "PM",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  hour_24 <- case_when(
    ampm_clean == "AM" & hour == 12 ~ 0,
    ampm_clean == "PM" & hour != 12 ~ hour + 12,
    TRUE ~ hour
  )

  hour_24 * 60 + minute
}
```

# Creating work summary variables for employment filtering

MIDUS 2 has no shift-type variable, so employment status is derived from
diary-reported work:

-   `is_fulltime`: total work hours summed across the diary week \>= 36.
-   `is_standard_shift`: average work start AND end times both fall
    between 6 AM and 8 PM.

```{r}
M2_work_summary <- M2_long %>%
  mutate(
    # Total work duration in minutes
    work_duration_minutes = case_when(
      is.na(work_hours) & is.na(work_minutes) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ coalesce(work_hours, 0) * 60 +
        coalesce(work_minutes, 0)
    ),

    # Start and end times in decimal hours
    work_start_time = convert_to_minutes(
      work_start_hour,
      work_start_minute,
      work_start_ampm
    ) / 60,

    work_end_time = convert_to_minutes(
      work_end_hour,
      work_end_minute,
      work_end_ampm
    ) / 60,

    worked_today = !is.na(work_duration_minutes) &
      work_duration_minutes > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    days_worked = sum(worked_today),

    total_work_hours =
      sum(work_duration_minutes[worked_today], na.rm = TRUE) / 60,

    average_start_time =
      mean(work_start_time[worked_today], na.rm = TRUE),

    average_end_time =
      mean(work_end_time[worked_today], na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # NaN (no worked days) -> NA
    across(
      c(
        average_start_time,
        average_end_time
      ),
      ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA_real_, .x)
    ),

    is_fulltime = case_when(
      is.na(total_work_hours) ~ 0,
      total_work_hours >= 36 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),

    is_standard_shift = case_when(
      is.na(average_start_time) | is.na(average_end_time) ~ 0,
      average_start_time >= 6 & average_start_time <= 20 &
        average_end_time >= 6 & average_end_time <= 20 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )
```

# Creating daily TV and sleep variables

```{r}
M2_daily_prepared <- M2_long %>%
  mutate(

    # TV in minutes (missing only if both hours and minutes are missing)
    tv_duration_minutes = case_when(
      is.na(tv_hours) & is.na(tv_minutes) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~
        coalesce(tv_hours, 0) * 60 +
        coalesce(tv_minutes, 0)
    ),

    # 1 = any TV that day, 0 = none, NA = TV missing
    watched_tv = case_when(
      is.na(tv_duration_minutes) ~ NA_integer_,
      tv_duration_minutes > 0 ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    ),

    tv_duration_if_watched = case_when(
      tv_duration_minutes > 0 ~ tv_duration_minutes,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Sleep in minutes (reported sleep reflects the previous night)
    sleep_duration_minutes = case_when(
      is.na(sleep_hours) & is.na(sleep_minutes) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~
        coalesce(sleep_hours, 0) * 60 +
        coalesce(sleep_minutes, 0)
    )
  )
```

# Recoding implausible values

Per the prereg, only impossible values (negative or \> 24 hours) are set
to missing. Plausible but extreme values are retained. Days where TV +
sleep exceed 24 hours are flagged, not excluded.

```{r}
# Implausible values before recoding
implausible_tv_before <- sum(
  M2_daily_prepared$tv_duration_minutes < 0 |
    M2_daily_prepared$tv_duration_minutes > 24 * 60,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

implausible_sleep_before <- sum(
  M2_daily_prepared$sleep_duration_minutes < 0 |
    M2_daily_prepared$sleep_duration_minutes > 24 * 60,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

implausible_tv_before
implausible_sleep_before

# Recoding implausible values as missing
M2_daily_prepared <- M2_daily_prepared %>%
  mutate(
    tv_duration_minutes = if_else(
      tv_duration_minutes < 0 | tv_duration_minutes > 24 * 60,
      NA_real_,
      tv_duration_minutes
    ),

    sleep_duration_minutes = if_else(
      sleep_duration_minutes < 0 | sleep_duration_minutes > 24 * 60,
      NA_real_,
      sleep_duration_minutes
    ),

    tv_plus_sleep_over_24h = case_when(
      is.na(tv_duration_minutes) | is.na(sleep_duration_minutes) ~ NA,
      (tv_duration_minutes + sleep_duration_minutes) > 24 * 60 ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

# QC: no implausible values remain
stopifnot(
  sum(M2_daily_prepared$tv_duration_minutes < 0 |
        M2_daily_prepared$tv_duration_minutes > 24 * 60, na.rm = TRUE) == 0,
  sum(M2_daily_prepared$sleep_duration_minutes < 0 |
        M2_daily_prepared$sleep_duration_minutes > 24 * 60, na.rm = TRUE) == 0
)

# Number of days flagged as TV + sleep > 24 hours
sum(M2_daily_prepared$tv_plus_sleep_over_24h, na.rm = TRUE)
```

# Missingness and ranges of daily TV and sleep

```{r}
M2_daily_prepared %>%
  summarise(
    diary_rows = n(),
    participants = n_distinct(id),

    missing_tv_n = sum(is.na(tv_duration_minutes)),
    missing_tv_percent =
      mean(is.na(tv_duration_minutes)) * 100,
    minimum_tv_minutes =
      min(tv_duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum_tv_minutes =
      max(tv_duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),

    missing_sleep_n = sum(is.na(sleep_duration_minutes)),
    missing_sleep_percent =
      mean(is.na(sleep_duration_minutes)) * 100,
    minimum_sleep_minutes =
      min(sleep_duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum_sleep_minutes =
      max(sleep_duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# QC: one record per participant per diary day
stopifnot(
  nrow(count(M2_daily_prepared, id, diary_day) %>% filter(n != 1)) == 0
)
```

# Aligning TV (day t) with that night's sleep (reported on day t + 1)

TV on diary days 1-7 is paired with sleep reported on days 2-8, so day-8
TV and day-1 sleep drop out (per the prereg).

```{r}
M2_lagged <- M2_daily_prepared %>%
  arrange(id, diary_day) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    next_diary_day = lead(diary_day),
    sleep_next_night_minutes =
      lead(sleep_duration_minutes)
  ) %>%
  # Keeping only consecutive interview days
  filter(
    next_diary_day == diary_day + 1
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

M2_lagged %>%
  summarise(
    lagged_rows = n(),
    participants = n_distinct(id),
    missing_tv_n = sum(is.na(tv_duration_minutes)),
    missing_next_sleep_n = sum(is.na(sleep_next_night_minutes)),
    complete_tv_sleep_pairs =
      sum(
        !is.na(tv_duration_minutes) &
          !is.na(sleep_next_night_minutes)
      )
  )
```

# Creating the final analysis dataset

No rows are removed here. Each model uses the observations that are
complete for its own variables.

```{r}
M2_analysis <- M2_lagged %>%
  left_join(
    M2_work_summary,
    by = "id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    missing_tv = as.integer(is.na(tv_duration_minutes)),
    missing_sleep = as.integer(is.na(sleep_next_night_minutes)),
    # First TV / next-night sleep pair (for the first-day sensitivity models)
    first_day = as.integer(diary_day == 1)
  )

stopifnot(nrow(M2_analysis) == nrow(M2_lagged))

# Log-transformed TV (right-skewed; used in the secondary log-TV models)
M2_analysis$tv_duration_minutes_log <- log1p(M2_analysis$tv_duration_minutes)

# Weekend indicator (prereg Level-1 control): TV day is Saturday or Sunday,
# so the paired sleep outcome is Saturday or Sunday night.
M2_analysis <- M2_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    weekend = as.integer(weekday %in% c(6, 7))
  )

M2_analysis_data <- M2_analysis
```

# Sample size under each filter

```{r}
filter_preview <- tibble(
  Stage = c(
    "Whole dataset",
    "Full-time only",
    "Full-time + standard shift",
    "Full-time + standard shift + no head injury/neuro disorder/chronic sleep problem"
  ),

  Observations = c(
    nrow(M2_analysis_data),

    M2_analysis_data %>%
      filter(is_fulltime == 1) %>%
      nrow(),

    M2_analysis_data %>%
      filter(is_fulltime == 1, is_standard_shift == 1) %>%
      nrow(),

    M2_analysis_data %>%
      filter(is_fulltime == 1, is_standard_shift == 1,
             head_injury == 0, neurological_disorder == 0,
             chronic_sleep_problem == 0) %>%
      nrow()
  ),

  Participants = c(
    n_distinct(M2_analysis_data$id),

    M2_analysis_data %>%
      filter(is_fulltime == 1) %>%
      summarise(n = n_distinct(id)) %>%
      pull(n),

    M2_analysis_data %>%
      filter(is_fulltime == 1, is_standard_shift == 1) %>%
      summarise(n = n_distinct(id)) %>%
      pull(n),

    M2_analysis_data %>%
      filter(is_fulltime == 1, is_standard_shift == 1,
             head_injury == 0, neurological_disorder == 0,
             chronic_sleep_problem == 0) %>%
      summarise(n = n_distinct(id)) %>%
      pull(n)
  )
)

filter_preview
```

# Describing the full sample

```{r}
# Age (participant level)
M2_analysis_data %>%
  distinct(id, age) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_age = min(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_age = max(age, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Sex (0 = male, 1 = female)
M2_analysis_data %>%
  distinct(id, sex) %>%
  count(sex) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = n / sum(n) * 100
  )

# TV viewing in minutes (raw and log-transformed)
M2_analysis_data %>%
  summarise(
    mean_tv = mean(tv_duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_tv = sd(tv_duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_tv = median(tv_duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_tv = min(tv_duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_tv = max(tv_duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_tv_log = mean(tv_duration_minutes_log, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_tv_log = sd(tv_duration_minutes_log, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_tv_log = median(tv_duration_minutes_log, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Next-night sleep in minutes
M2_analysis_data %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sleep = mean(sleep_next_night_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sleep = sd(sleep_next_night_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_sleep = median(sleep_next_night_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_sleep = min(sleep_next_night_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_sleep = max(sleep_next_night_minutes, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

# Saving the analysis datasets

All analysis samples are restricted to full-time, standard-shift
participants (prereg). The sensitivity samples build on that.

```{r}
# Whole sample (unfiltered)
saveRDS(M2_analysis_data, "M2_analysis_data.rds")

# Primary (prereg): full-time + standard shift
M2_analysis_data_fulltime_standard <- M2_analysis_data %>%
  filter(
    is_fulltime == 1,
    is_standard_shift == 1
  )

saveRDS(
  M2_analysis_data_fulltime_standard,
  "M2_analysis_data_fulltime_standard.rds"
)

# Sensitivity: siblings and twins excluded
non_sibling_twin_ids <- unique(M2_main_sample$M2ID)

M2_analysis_data_no_sibtwin <- M2_analysis_data_fulltime_standard %>%
  filter(id %in% non_sibling_twin_ids)

saveRDS(
  M2_analysis_data_no_sibtwin,
  "M2_analysis_data_no_sibtwin.rds"
)

# Sensitivity: one randomly selected participant per family (M2FAMNUM)
set.seed(2026)

one_per_family_ids <- M2_analysis_data_fulltime_standard %>%
  distinct(id, M2FAMNUM) %>%
  group_by(M2FAMNUM) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pull(id)

M2_analysis_data_one_per_family <- M2_analysis_data_fulltime_standard %>%
  filter(id %in% one_per_family_ids)

saveRDS(
  M2_analysis_data_one_per_family,
  "M2_analysis_data_one_per_family.rds"
)

# Sensitivity: diary days on which TV was watched
M2_analysis_data_tv_watchers <- M2_analysis_data_fulltime_standard %>%
  filter(watched_tv == 1)

saveRDS(
  M2_analysis_data_tv_watchers,
  "M2_analysis_data_tv_watchers.rds"
)

# Secondary (prereg secondary analysis 3): no head injury,
# neurological disorder, or chronic sleep problem
M2_analysis_data_no_health_conditions <- M2_analysis_data_fulltime_standard %>%
  filter(
    head_injury == 0,
    neurological_disorder == 0,
    chronic_sleep_problem == 0
  )

saveRDS(
  M2_analysis_data_no_health_conditions,
  "M2_analysis_data_no_health_conditions.rds"
)
```

  Participants = c(
